messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — ACME Bank is asking for an artifacts pack for their vendor risk review: (1) a simple dataflow diagram showing EU-only processing, (2) redacted subprocessor list, and (3) confirmation we can pin processing to an EU region for their POC. They want something to hand to procurement by Friday. Can we do an expedited deliverable?
Mira (Security): @Alex yes. We have EU-hosted endpoints and Redwood Private options. For hosted accounts we can route and pin to eu-west or eu-central. I can produce a redacted subprocessor list + a one-page diagram. Do we need a full SIG/CAIQ or just a summary?
Alex (Sales): Procurement asked for a short answers pack first (dataflow + subproc list + residency note). If they escalate to SIG later, we'll coordinate. POC kickoff is next Monday.
Dan (Solutions): I can sketch the dataflow and include a small code/config snippet for region pinning. Draft diagram ASCII (will convert to Visio/PNG):
```
Client -> TLS -> ALB (eu-west) -> Ingress service (tenant routing) -> Model runtime (KV cache, GPU) -> KMS for encryption-at-rest
Logs (audit) -> S3 (eu-west)
Metrics -> Prometheus/Grafana (eu-west)
Fallback: if capacity exhausted, we route to dedicated EU-only pool or queue requests (no cross-region writes)
```
Dan (Solutions): Note: Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS by default; for Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS). I'll annotate which boxes contain customer data vs telemetry.
Mira (Security): For the redacted subprocessor list I can include categories: cloud infra (AWS eu-west-1), observability vendor (vendor-x, EU data residency), model hosting partners (redacted names optional), SSO/IdP (Okta). Will provide CSV for legal.
Jordan (Legal): For the procurement packet I can draft a short statement confirming: (a) we will process customer inference requests in the specified EU region for the POC, (b) subprocessor list will be redacted for partners' commercial sensitivity, (c) for full SIG/CAIQ responses we need a signed NDA + completed SOW. I can sign off on the redacted pack.
Alex (Sales): Timeline: Dan/Mira aim for a first-pass by tomorrow 12:00pm PT. Jordan will review and produce the cover note by EOD tomorrow. I will deliver to customer Friday morning.
Mira (Security): Ack. I'll attach the redacted subprocessor CSV and the exported PNG of the dataflow here when done. Will call out encryption, at-rest/in-transit, key ownership, and retention windows.
deploy-bot: Note: created internal folder /artifacts/ACME-POC/1998765432 and set ACL to sales+security.
Dan (Solutions): Small config sample for region pinning to include in the pack:
```json
{ "account_id": "acct-xxxx", "region": "eu-west-1", "model_variant": "redwood-2b-quantized", "kms": { "type": "customer-managed", "key_id": "projects/..../keyrings/..../cryptoKeys/.." } }
```
Alex (Sales): Perfect. If anything blocks you ping me. cc @Jordan (Legal) for sign-off. :thumbsup:
Mira (Security): One question for Dan: do we need to call out KV cache eviction policies in the diagram for procurement? They asked about transient storage of prompt history.
Dan (Solutions): Yes — add a small note: KV cache is ephemeral (GPU memory + short-lived SSD), never persisted to durable storage unless customer opt-in for session logs; default retention = 0.
Jordan (Legal): Good — I'll include that wording in the cover note (ephemeral vs durable storage).
Alex (Sales): Thanks all — please upload links to the internal folder when ready and I'll assemble the final ZIP for ACME.
Mira (Security): Will do.
